spell.zoltraak_cinematic.zoltraak.desc: Ordinary Offensive Magic (人類の魔法). Fires a fast piercing beam with a 12-block impact shockwave and bright glow.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.corrupted_zoltr: Qual's forbidden magic. Fires a dark void beam with magenta flares that pierces armor, shatters barriers, and withers targets.
Pierces Armor, Shatters Barriers & Inflicts Wither
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.zoltraak_barrag: Summons 24 magic circles around you, rapidly firing guided light beams at your target.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.corrupted_barra: Summons 24 dark magic circles that fire corrupted bolts to break barriers and wither enemies.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.frieren_staff.de: Iconic staff of the ancient elven mage Frieren. Amplifies all Spell Power (+20%), Zoltraak Spell Power (+20%), and Mana Regen.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.mirror_lotus_rin: Engraved with the mirror lotus flower. Symbolizes eternal devotion and grants +15% Zoltraak Spell Power, Cooldown, Cast Speed, and Mana Regen.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.mana_concealment: Compresses your mana aura using ancient elven discipline. Grants +25% Zoltraak Resistance and +10% Spell Resistance.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.ordinary_grimoir: Ancient 10-slot spellbook detailing the foundations of humanity's ordinary offensive magic.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.defense.desc: Creates a hexagonal magic barrier (front shield, or 360° dome when sneaking) while still letting you cast attack spells.
ui.zoltraak_cinematic.defense_not_in_spe: Defensive Magic is not in your equipped spellbook!
ui.zoltraak_cinematic.flight_not_in_spel: Flight Magic is not in your equipped spellbook!
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.flight.desc: Allows free 3D flight in midair using mana over time. Flying high or sprinting uses much more mana.
ui.zoltraak_cinematic.flight_exponential: §cTip: Flying higher or faster drains much more mana.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.elder_sage_grimo: Qual's forbidden spellbook containing the original formula of Killing Magic (Zoltraak).
item.zoltraak_cinematic.horn_of_corrupti: The severed demonic horn of Qual, saturated with primordial Zoltraak mana. Used to craft mythic artifacts.
Singularity core taken from the Elder Sage. Grants high Zoltraak power and fast mana recovery.
message.zoltraak_cinematic.unsealing_sta: §c⚠ The ancient seal begins to crack! Frieren's runes turn blood-red! ⚠
item.zoltraak_cinematic.gargantua_scroll: Tip: Inscribe into a Spellbook at the Inscription Table to keep this spell permanently.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.gargantua.desc: Summons a massive black hole that pulls in blocks, projectiles, and enemies before collapsing in a huge blast.
death.attack.gargantua: %1$s was crushed by the Gargantua Black Hole.
death.attack.gargantua.player: %1$s was pulled into the Black Hole cast by %2$s.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.explosion.desc: Channels crimson sky rings over a target before unleashing a catastrophic stylized detonation that drains all remaining mana.
death.attack.explosion.player: %1$s was reduced to ash by %2$s's Explosion Magic.
subtitles.zoltraak_cinematic.explosion_c: Explosion rings resonate across the sky
item.zoltraak_cinematic.chronos_dilatati: Grants +10% Cooldown Reduction and +25% Black Hole Spell Power. Right-click while held to unleash a Time Dilation Field that slows nearby enemies (reduced effect on bosses).
config.zoltraak_cinematic.title: Zoltraak Visual Settings
config.zoltraak_cinematic.subtitle: Effects, Shaders & Audio
config.zoltraak_cinematic.reset.tooltip: Reset all visual settings back to defaults.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.barrier_view.c: Keeps the center clear for aiming while showing edges.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.barrier_view.m: Faint barrier that flashes brightly only when hit.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.barrier_view.e: Draws only the outer frame so the center stays clear.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.barrier_view.f: Shows the full barrier pattern in first-person.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.barrier: How visible the barrier looks in first-person (0% = visible only on hit).
config.zoltraak_cinematic.circle_view.ce: Fades center light and bloom around the crosshair while keeping the outer ring crisp.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.circle_view.mi: Shows a subtle, low-bloom magic circle so the beam and target stay clear.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.circle_view.ed: Draws only the outer rune border with a clear center and minimal bloom.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.circle_view.fu: Shows the full brightness and bloom of the magic circle in first-person.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.circle_: First-person magic circle opacity and Iris bloom strength (0% = hidden).
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.camera_: Shakes the screen during big explosions and beam blasts.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.shake_s: Adjusts how strong camera shake feels (1.0x = normal).
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.screen_: Bright white flash on huge blasts. Turn OFF if sensitive to flashes.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.flash_s: Controls how bright white screen flashes appear.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.flight_: Tilts the camera slightly when turning during Flight Magic.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.cinemat: Smooth zoom and orbit camera motion while casting Gargantua.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.hole_quality.l: Low (32 steps): Fastest FPS, slightly softer details.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.hole_quality.m: Medium (72 steps): Balanced quality and smooth performance.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.hole_quality.h: High (96 steps): Sharper disk curves and finer details.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.hole_quality.u: Ultra (128 steps): Maximum sharpness; heavy GPU cost.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.disk_si: Size of the glowing ring around Gargantua. Larger rings cost more GPU.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.lens_fl: Adds horizontal light streaks across bright beam cores.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.light_b: Warps and bends background light around the black hole.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.color_f: Subtle RGB color split around screen edges during big blasts.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.world_glow.sha: Lights up terrain and water only when Iris/Oculus shaders are active.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.world_glow.alw: Always lights up nearby terrain, even without shaders.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.world_glow.off: Disables spell lighting on terrain for maximum FPS.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.mod_aud: Master volume for all Zoltraak spells, beams, and black hole sounds.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.bloom_z: Glow brightness for standard and corrupted Zoltraak beams.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.bloom_g: Glow brightness for large overcharged Zoltraak beams.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.bloom_b: Glow brightness for magic circles and rapid barrage bolts.
Glow brightness for hexagonal shields and hit sparks.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.bloom_g: Glow brightness for the black hole core and glowing ring.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.bloom_q: Glow brightness for Qual boss runes and the sealing stone.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.bloom_e: Glow brightness for Explosion Magic sky rings, strike beam, and blast dome.
config.zoltraak_cinematic.option.explosi: Number of rising golden spark dots orbiting around the caster while channeling Explosion.
Number of multicolor 4-point stars spiralling around the caster during charge.
Number of sparks and stars arcing in a parabolic trajectory up into the sky vortex rings.
Number of intersecting golden cross-ray beams radiating through the staff rainbow ring.
Number of energy suction trails pulled inward through the staff rainbow shockwave ring.
Controls the width and brightness of the horizontal lens flare across the sky vortex rings.
Overall size scale multiplier for golden sparks, 4-point stars, cross-rays, and suction streaks.
Controls how high above the target the 8 sky magic rings and vertical sky pillar tower (100% = ~69 blocks high at default radius).
Controls the horizontal radius of the 8 stacked sky magic rings above the blast target live in-game (40% to 250%).
Visual scale multiplier for the fireball dome, shockwaves, and dust clouds (does not change damage or block crater size).
